secrets.name: QODANA_TOKEN
secrets.purpose: Authenticate trusted Qodana analysis uploads for the two isolated surfaces.
secrets.rotationProcedure: Revoke the project token, create its replacement, and update the repository secret before re-enabling trusted analysis.

secrets.name: SONAR_TOKEN
secrets.purpose: Authenticate trusted Sonar analysis for the two isolated projects.
secrets.rotationProcedure: Revoke the analysis token, create its replacement, and update the repository secret before re-enabling trusted analysis.

secrets.name: CERTIFICATE_CHAIN
secrets.purpose: Provide the public certificate chain used by the native JetBrains plugin signing tasks.
secrets.rotationProcedure: Replace the protected certificate chain together with the matching private key, record the new public fingerprint, and verify a dry-run before publication.

secrets.name: PRIVATE_KEY
secrets.purpose: Provide the private signing key only to the protected JetBrains release job.
secrets.rotationProcedure: Revoke the matching certificate, generate a replacement key outside the repository, update the protected environment, and verify a dry-run before publication.

secrets.name: PRIVATE_KEY_PASSWORD
secrets.purpose: Unlock the protected JetBrains plugin signing key during the release job.
secrets.rotationProcedure: Re-encrypt or replace the private key, update this protected environment secret, and verify a dry-run before publication.

secrets.name: PUBLISH_TOKEN
secrets.purpose: Authenticate the final stable upload to JetBrains Marketplace after signature verification.
secrets.rotationProcedure: Revoke the Marketplace token, create a replacement with the minimum publishing scope, update the protected environment, and verify a dry-run before publication.
